items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: I played around here with Jelly Roll.

ctx.x: Oh, do you remember... No, you weren't here when Jelly Roll was out here, I guess, much.
At Leakes Lake. Sure. Where are you here? I played around here with Jelly Roll. That's right.
He was here then. You weren't here though when Buddy Petit and Frankie Dusen came out, were you?
